question: Q-N-M2-D1
text: For Manhattan → Manhattan trips in 2024, the 10 pickup zones with the highest fare per mile among zones with at least 10,000 such trips.
interpretation: Manhattan -> Manhattan trips in 2024: the 10 pickup zones with the highest fare per mile among zones with at least 10,000 such trips (ties: location id).
assemble: WITH ranked AS (SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fare_per_mile DESC, pu_location_id) AS rank_no FROM q WHERE trips >= 10000) SELECT rank_no, pu_location_id, zone, trips, fare_per_mile FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY rank_no
